title: derris brachyptera
intro: Derris brachyptera, commonly known as Takhmao or Takhmao root, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia, belonging to the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin diseases, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Derris brachyptera include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Derris brachyptera include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
